comment: Blessed from the pinned engine, hand-checked to the dollar: a March–July form (five months at 500 / 550 / 250), the monthly route (Form 8962 lines 12-23). Five months of 550 − 309 (the 3,708 annual contribution over 12) = 241 of assistance each, capped at the 500 premium: 1,205 of credit against 1,250 of advance payments, 45 repaid, line 24 4,115 → 4,160.
